Sergio / Laura — forwarding Anjali’s note. This looks like an OAuth relay/consent redirect problem we’ve seen when customers have an IdP or strict cookie policy. Quick things to try (workaround while Ops investigates):

1) Ask vendor to clear cookies and try an incognito window (fastest).
2) Resend invite using "Resend Activation" from the portal (different token path).
3) If still failing, we can do manual activation on our side and attach the W‑9 to the vendor profile; that gets POs moving while we debug.

I’ve opened RI‑20481 with Portal Ops and included logs; they’ll check the redirect chain and nameid mapping. I’ll paste updates here.

Ticket: https://redwood.support/ticket/RI-20481

—Ben

Hi Anjali,

Thanks for the quick test and screenshot — that was helpful. I spoke to Portal Ops and they confirmed the redirect loop was caused by your network inserting a corporate SSO consent intermediary that breaks the Coupa accept flow. Portal Ops has manually provisioned the supplier record and uploaded your W‑9 so you’ll see Nutravia as an active supplier in our system.

Actions we completed for you:
- Manually created the Nutravia supplier profile and attached the received W‑9 (Nutravia_W9.pdf).
- Sent a one‑time login magic link to procurement@nutraviafoods.com (subject: "Redwood — supplier portal access (one‑time)").
- Opened RI‑20481 for our engineering team to fix the SSO redirect handling; Ops will follow up if they need any network headers from your IdP team.

Next steps for you: please use the new magic link to set a local portal password and confirm your primary remittance info. If you hit any issue, reply and I’ll escalate for same‑day assistance.

Apologies for the friction — we’ll also try to add an IdP‑friendly path in the invite flow to prevent this for other customers.
